provenance: Synthetic authored scenarios for an engineering smoke test. NOT real user data, a benchmark corpus, or a production RAG comparison

documents.text: The API gateway returns 429 Too Many Requests after the per-minute token budget is exhausted. Use bounded exponential backoff and respect retry-after.
导入 PDF 后先保存原件，完成文本解析和分块，写入 SQLite FTS5。语义向量计算可以在后台执行，不要阻塞首次搜索。
For an MCP tool call timeout, log request ID and server response status, then retry only idempotent operations. A completed payment must not be replayed.
个人助手执行删除文件、发邮件、购买等高风险动作前，必须校验权限并请求用户批准，还需要生成审计记录。
An offline photo index stores image embeddings in local SQLite. Text queries can retrieve matching photos if query and image embeddings share the same semantic space.
音频转录与声学语义检索是不同任务。无需先转录的音频向量检索必须有专门音频编码器支持，并实际测试准确率。
Personal long-term memory should hold stable preferences, not transient hotel quotes. Current task state tracks deadlines, permissions, and pending approval.
iPhone 13 端侧模型加载要控制峰值内存，测量冷启动延迟、常驻内存、发热与电池消耗。Mac 测试数据不能代表 iPhone 结果。
A full multilingual RAG evaluation needs retrieval recall at K, mean reciprocal rank, cross-language questions and adversarial negatives.
索引模型升级时，旧模型生成的向量不能直接与新模型的向量混合比较，应保留旧索引并进行版本迁移和回滚测试。
